## 1. Company Profile & Overview

TECHNAVIA (https://technaviatechnology.com) is a premium B2B Web Engineering and AI Automation studio turning corporate websites into high-ranking search assets, LLM-cited knowledge entities, and autonomous lead-to-CRM automation engines.

## 2. The 3 Core Engineering Systems

### Service 01: Web Development + Technical SEO
- Overview: Fast, conversion-focused websites engineered with clean Next.js server components, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, and sub-400ms Largest Contentful Paint so Google indexes and ranks pages from day one.
- Architecture: Next.js 16 Server Components, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Core Web Vitals Guarantees: 95+ Mobile Lighthouse performance, Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) under 1.0s, zero hydration bloat.
- SEO Implementation: Zero client-side render blocking, clean semantic HTML5 landmarks, automatic WebP image optimization, server-rendered OpenGraph metadata, and dynamic sitemaps.
- Canonical URL: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/web-development-seo

### Service 02: LLM Visibility (AEO / GEO)
- Overview: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) that position your company as the authoritative citation when buyers prompt AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude).
- Architecture: Deep JSON-LD Knowledge Graphs, Quotable Answer-Capsules, Entity Graph mapping across official sameAs nodes.
- Outcome: Deterministic citation readiness for high-intent B2B vendor prompts.
- Canonical URL: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/llm-visibility

### Service 03: Custom AI Automations
- Overview: Event-driven autonomous pipelines that qualify inbound enquiries, enrich firmographics, schedule meetings, and sync CRMs while your team sleeps.
- Architecture: Production n8n workflows, Clearbit/Apollo data enrichment, LLM ICP scoring, dynamic calendar booking links, two-way CRM sync (HubSpot/Salesforce), and Slack alerts.
- Outcome: Average lead response under 60 seconds, eliminating manual triage bottlenecks completely.
- Canonical URL: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/ai-automations
